seo.title: Request a Service Call — Cedar Mill Plumbing
seo.description: Tell me what's going on with the plumbing — about 2 minutes to fill out. I'll respond personally inside a few hours during business days with scheduling options.

header.heading: Tell me what's going on with the plumbing.
header.lead: About two minutes. I'll reach out personally within a few hours during business days with scheduling options. If it's an active emergency right now (burst pipe, sewage backup, no hot water tonight, gas smell), please call (503) 555-0149 instead — the form is checked during business hours; the phone is checked 24/7.

form.subject: New service request from Cedar Mill Plumbing
form.successMessage: Got it — your request is in. I'll reach out within a few hours with scheduling options.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or call directly: (503) 555-0149.

steps.title: What's going on with the plumbing?
steps.description: Pick the closest fit. We'll go deeper at the visit — this is just so I bring the right gear in the truck.

options.label: Drain or backup
options.description: Slow, gurgling, or fully backed up — branch drain or mainline.

options.label: Water heater
options.description: No hot water, leaking tank, or planning a replacement.

options.label: Leak repair / detection
options.description: Visible drip, hidden leak, slab leak, or unexplained water bill.

options.label: Repipe or larger project
options.description: Galvanized or polybutylene replacement, or a planned remodel rough-in.

options.label: Fixture work
options.description: Faucet, toilet, hose bib, or shutoff replacement.

options.label: Something else
options.description: Tell me at the details step — I'll be honest about whether I'm the right plumber for the job.

steps.title: How soon do you need someone out?
steps.description: No wrong answer — this just helps me get you on the right slot. If it's actively leaking right now, please call (503) 555-0149 instead.

options.label: Emergency right now
options.description: Active leak, sewage backup, no hot water tonight — please call (503) 555-0149 instead.

options.label: This week if possible
options.description: Working but want it handled soon.

options.label: Next week is fine
options.description: Routine — book it at my convenience.

options.label: Estimate for a project
options.description: Planning ahead, looking for a written quote.

steps.title: Where's the house?
steps.description: I cover Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and NW Portland (97225, 97229, 97006, 97005, 97124, 97210, 97231). Outside that radius I usually decline so I can hit response times inside it.

options.label: Somewhere else
options.description: I'll tell you straight whether it's inside the service radius.

steps.title: What kind of property?
steps.description: Most of my work is single-family residential. I do small property-management portfolios but not new commercial construction.

options.label: Rental I own
options.description: I'll work directly with you or with the tenant.

options.label: Remodel / new build
options.description: Working with a GC or doing it yourself.

options.label: Something else
options.description: Tell me at the details step.

steps.title: How do I reach you?
steps.description: First name is fine. Phone is the fastest way for scheduling — I'll text or call back, your preference.

steps.title: Anything else I should know?
steps.description: What's happening, when it started, where in the house. Any unusual access — crawlspace, finished ceiling, pets that need to be put away. The more I know up front, the more efficient the visit.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Note (optional)
fields.placeholder: What's going on, when it started, where in the house. Anything weird about access. Photos welcome at the visit — no need to attach here.

fields.name: terms
fields.label: I understand this form is for non-emergency requests. If I have an active emergency right now (burst pipe, sewage backup, no hot water tonight, gas smell), I will call (503) 555-0149 directly. I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
